name: Two async starts run synchronously to their first incomplete await

input.source_text: mut log = []; class A { public async fun f(gate: Object, tag: Symbol) -> Symbol { log.append(tag); await gate; tag } } module M { public fun run() -> Array { let gate = Gate.new(); let a = A.new().f(gate, :a); let b = A.new().f(gate, :b); log } } M.run()

applicability.reason: The synchronous prefix before each incomplete await is observable from source.
